name: addpipe24_ks_fused_window16
rationale: The fusion trend across attempts 13->14 (window4 SOP fused into 1 blob: area 534.66/WNS 7.486; window8: area 510.19/WNS 7.510) shows that merging more explicit 2-input KS stages into one flat sliding-window boolean expression lets ABC rebalance/share logic more effectively than staged wires, monotonically improving area while WNS creeps toward the 530.936-area baseline (7.51866). Extending this one more doubling: fuse the first 4 canonical KS stages (stride 1,2,4,8) into a single flat 16-wide sliding-window generate/propagate SOP (boundary-safe via 15 virtual identity padding elements, same safe pattern validated in the window8 attempt), leaving only one remaining explicit stride-16 doubling stage to cover the full 24-bit cumulative-carry range. This continues the empirically-validated fusion trend and should further cut combine-node/stage overhead versus window8 while keeping the same effective logical depth (~5 levels total, matching full KS/baseline), targeting area below 510 with WNS remaining close to baseline, a new likely-improved point on the area/WNS frontier.
